The *Caturitthivimānavatthu* ("Four Women Mansion", Vv 45) is a canonical text in the *Vimānavatthu* collection [SuttaCentral]. The narrative framework features the Arahant Moggallāna questioning four female *deva*s about the meritorious actions they carried out in their previous lives that resulted in their remarkably radiant celestial bodies [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral notes five translations of the text in five languages [SuttaCentral].
